strings.home.title: Home
strings.home.emptyBody: Play a video or subscribe to a channel from the search page to fill your Continue watching, Discover and New from your subscriptions. In the meantime, Recommended and Trending are above.
strings.history.title: History
strings.history.clearBody: The %1 videos in your history will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.
strings.history.empty: You haven't watched any video yet. The ones you open will appear here.
strings.search.title: Search
strings.search.clearBody: Your saved searches will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.
strings.channel.title: Channel
strings.channel.emptyLive: This channel has no live streams.
strings.library.title: Library
strings.library.noSubs: You haven't subscribed to any channel yet. Open a video or a channel and press «Subscribe».
strings.library.favEmpty: Press «Like» on a video and it will appear here.
strings.library.watchLaterEmpty: Press the clock on a video to save it here.
strings.library.historyEmpty: The videos you watch will appear here.
strings.library.playlistEmpty: Create your first playlist with «+ New».
strings.playlist.title: Playlist
strings.playlist.removeTip: Remove the marked video from the playlist
strings.playlist.deleteBody: %1 will be deleted along with its %2 videos. This action cannot be undone.
strings.playlist.empty: This playlist has no videos yet. Add them from a video's menu.
strings.error.recoveryFailed: Playback was interrupted and could not be recovered.
strings.error.openUrl: Could not open the video URL
strings.error.streamInfo: Could not read the stream information
strings.error.noVideoTrack: No video track found in the stream
strings.error.masterStale: fetchMaster for a different id than the current one
strings.error.playerJson: player response is not valid JSON
strings.error.hlsMissing: player OK but with no hlsManifestUrl
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.audioLangNote: Note: the preference applies only when the video has a track in that language. If there is none, the original audio is used.
strings.settings.volumeMaxBody: Raising the maximum volume to %1 can cause permanent hearing damage. Use it only with external speakers and at a comfortable level. When you close the app the volume will return to 100% even if you raise it higher. Continue?
strings.settings.volumeMaxNote: For safety, the volume is only saved up to 100%. When you restart the app, even if the setting is higher, playback will start at 100%.
strings.settings.accentNote: Applied instantly: sliders, progress, highlighted buttons, text selection and active icons.
strings.settings.thumbSizeNote: Small: 6 videos per row on Home and short rows in search, history and queue. Large: 4 per row and a bigger thumbnail.
strings.settings.clearThumbsBody: Delete all saved thumbnails? The images will be downloaded again.
strings.settings.resetBody: This action will erase the local database (history, searches, subscriptions and settings) and the thumbnail cache. No personal files or downloaded videos will be deleted. The application will restart with default values. Continue?
strings.settings.aboutNote: No telemetry: this application sends no usage, search or history data to any server. Everything stays local on your device.
